lessons.description: Seven to ten questions on WhatsApp and conversational marketing, with an answer key.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in WhatsApp & Conversational Marketing, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. What makes conversational marketing different from email marketing?
+ It is a two-way thread the customer can reply to, and expects a quick answer
- It costs less to send
- It cannot be automated
= The medium sets the expectation. A chat message implies a conversation, not a broadcast.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.
